Jisie ike! Grandma is dancing in the village.
See brain! I'm calling your uncle to brag.
Correct! You'll get extra meat in your soup tonight.
Chineke! Who taught you? Oh yes, me.
Three in a row! Are you sure you were born abroad?
Look at you! I'll tell the whole WhatsApp group.
Ah-ah! Is it Igbo you're dreaming in now?
Ehn?! After all the school fees?
Who taught you this? Not me o.

meaning_or_note: I am Igbo. I speak a little Igbo. (lesson line)
My mother is at home (lesson line)
They are fine. Thank you. (lesson line)

meaning_or_note: I'm tired, but I'm happy. (lesson line)
